question: ΔPQR is right-angled at Q. The length of PQ is 5 cm and ∠PRQ = 30°. Determine the length of side QR.
solution:
**Given:**

∠PQR = 90°; ∠PRQ = 30°

PQ = 5 cm

**Concept used:**

Tan θ = P/B

Where,

P = perpendicular; B = base

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f3f5742eb2e00e03e36ee9c2538c009c17079405529a1884c90a2f30b4a22a2.png] 

From the figure:

⇒ Tan R = PQ/QR

⇒ Tan 30° = 5/QR

⇒ 1/√3 = 5/QR

⇒ QR = 5√3 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 5√3 cm.**
